scripts.build:pixie_web: bun run build:webui && bun run build:go
scripts.build:release:amd64: bun x bun@1.4.0 run scripts/build-release.ts --architecture amd64
scripts.build:release:arm64: bun x bun@1.4.0 run scripts/build-release.ts --architecture arm64
scripts.check:deps: bun run scripts/check-catalog.ts && bun run scripts/check-boundaries.ts
scripts.probe: bun run scripts/check-runtime.ts --exec -- bun run src/assistant/probe.ts
scripts.format: biome check --write src scripts tests webui/src webui/scripts schema package.json biome.json
scripts.lint: bun run check:filenames && bun run check:conventions && bun run check:config-schema && biome check src scripts tests webui/src webui/scripts schema package.json biome.json
scripts.test: bun run scripts/check-runtime.ts --exec -- bun run test:inner
scripts.test:inner: bun test tests/assistant tests/shared tests/build && go test ./...
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:source && bun run typecheck:tools && bun run typecheck:tests && bun run --cwd webui typecheck
